status: Private checkpoint ready for host-adapter design after the read-lifecycle migration; production sources unchanged.
implemented: Immutable per-agent FileMutationStore, host-bound ws1/apps/read-only att scopes
SQLite FULL/WAL durable before/after byte snapshots with missing distinct from empty; no undo-cache eviction
Single regular-file write, sequential multiEdit with unmatched skip and exact non-overlapping counts, copy/move/delete
Before-image staging with no-overwrite handle rename, conflict-aware rollback, agent-owned undo by mutation nonce
Restart recovery for prepared/applying/rolling_back/recovery_required and pending committed cleanup
Pinned absolute ancestor chain, file identities, reparse/hardlink refusal, original-mount identity checks
QLockFile serializes apply/undo/recovery for one journal owner, including separate process instances
Preflight UTF-8 replacement growth before each allocation; source non-overlapping match counts retained
Journal identities for reserved stage and rollback restore files before writing; partial stages and interrupted restores resume safely at tested boundaries
limits: Windows local-drive prototype only,4 MiB per file, existing parent directories, at most 2 changed paths; directories/recursive operations and parent creation not implemented
Host tool adapters, model definitions, UI, tool-call-group undo, contributor diffs, archive finalization and metadata preservation remain pending
Synchronous single-owner-thread QtSql API; not yet integrated into native worker/coordinator lifecycle
Temp fault callback is a private test seam, not a production authorization mechanism
No power-loss guarantee beyond SQLite FULL and FlushFileBuffers; actual abrupt process termination is tested
An exit between CREATE_NEW and its identity UPDATE can leave a reserved file with no durable identity; recovery fails closed with recovery_required instead of guessing ownership.
Per-file publication uses recoverable backup+publish renames, not a filesystem-wide atomic transaction or an expected-target compare-and-swap.
Raw sandbox mutation adapters, directory creation/copy-to-directory basename handling, recursive operations, full metadata/ACL retention, tool-call-group undo and diff UI remain pending.
History growth quota, schema migration/import/pruning, chat deletion/clone semantics and dedicated worker routing need implementation before production exposure.

reproduced_implementation_defects.cause: Qt6 QVariant::isNull does not identify a null contained QString, causing NOT NULL SQL insert failures; now normalize actual contained values.
Documented relative FILE_RENAME_INFO.RootDirectory failed Windows87; absolute canonical destinations pass while all ancestors are retained.
QString::count counts overlapping matches unlike source split semantics; explicit non-overlapping scan fixes editsApplied.
Live-owner recovery changed prepared work to rolled_back; oversized replace attempted a large allocation before the cap. Both fixed and regressed.
Partial reserved stage was not recognized for cleanup; published fallback restore had no durable identity and failed the next recovery. Both fixed.
Retry of an interrupted restore reopened its reserved stage without write access. Added GENERIC_WRITE for owned restore stages only.

independent_windows_probe.result: Ten relative directory-handle variants failed87; absolute-target controls succeeded. This independently corroborates actual platform behavior rather than documentation-only inference.

independent_review.scope: Read-only transaction/crash/owner-lock and follow-up changed identity paths; no independent rerun of the final test suite.
independent_review.final: No additional concrete defect found in the changed lock/stage/restore paths. The CREATE_NEW-to-identity-UPDATE interruption gap remains explicit.

static_imports: imports.txt contains only Windows system DLLs; no Qt or MinGW runtime DLL imports.
